subject: 英语
source: 人教版PEP小学英语（三年级起点）教材单元话题整理
original_text:
【核心词汇】old 年老的; young 年轻的; funny 滑稽的; kind 和蔼的; strict 严格的; polite 有礼貌的; hard-working 勤奋的; helpful 有帮助的; clever 聪明的; shy 害羞的
【重点句型】What's he like? 他是什么样的人？ He is ... 他是…… Who's your ... teacher? 谁是你们的……老师？ He/She is ... 他/她是…… Is he/she ...? 他/她……吗？ Yes, he/she is. / No, he/she isn't. 是的。/ 不是。 He's very helpful. 他很有帮助。
【A Let's talk】Wu Yifan: Who's your English teacher? Oliver: Mr Li. Wu Yifan: Is he young? Oliver: No, he isn't. He's old. He's very funny. Wu Yifan: Great! I like funny teachers.
【Read and write】I have a new teacher. She is our music teacher. She is young and kind. She is very funny. We like her. My maths teacher is strict but he is clever. My Chinese teacher is helpful.
key_points: What's he like? 他是什么样的人？
Who's your ... teacher? 谁是你们的……老师？
Yes, he/she is. / No, he/she isn't. 是的。/ 不是。
He's very helpful. 他很有帮助。
cautions: 只做内容骨架（核心词汇、重点句型、对话与短文范例），不生成老师逐字讲解稿；词汇与句型均依据该 PEP 单元目标语言整理，不得编造教材未出现的单词、语法点或例句。
